name: Mexico City by Night: Named Kindred (Lore)

pages.name: Melinda Galbraith / Zachary Sikorsky (The Regent's Impostor)

text.content: Regent Melinda Galbraith was murdered at the 2001 Palla Grande by an unknown killer who left a strange bloody sign on her chamber wall. The young @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} fleshcrafter Zachary Sikorsky, present to help with her festival "costume," panicked when he found her crumbling corpse — certain the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} would execute him as a convenient scapegoat rather than seek the truth — and used his shapeshifting talent to impersonate her rather than flee. He intended to finish the festival and vanish, but never found the chance: nights turned to months trapped inside Galbraith's retinue of bodyguards, aides, and supplicants. "Galbraith" has ruled as an impostor ever since, a fraud that cannot last forever. When it finally breaks, three prisci — the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra} Ultra-Conservative Charles VI, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} Moderate Szechenyi Jolán, and the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} antitribu @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference.JournalEntry.St7uVm2DqK4nRy8X]{Status} Quo candidate Venere Carboni — will contend to become the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s new regent, each drawing on a different ideological faction and demographic, in a crisis that can shake Mexico City's Sabbat from its consistory elders to its youngest fledglings.

pages.name: Charles VI, The People's Choice (Lasombra Priscus)

text.content: Charles Delmare, an 8th-generation French knight-turned-Cainite who fought on both sides of the Albigensian Crusade and the Anarch Revolt before becoming the sixth (and first long-surviving) @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} cardinal of South America in 1808, now sits on Mexico City's consistory as an elder priscus and the Ultra-Conservative candidate for regent. Charles plays every faction against the others — rallying Loyalists with speeches against elder tyranny while quietly arranging the destruction of neonates who oppose his fellow elders — and has grown genuinely alarmed by evidence of powers beyond the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}/@UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} Jyhad (shapeshifters, ghosts, unnamed things) gathered across two centuries of intelligence-gathering. He helped unleash the Sabbat Inquisition against infernalism and intends to grant it even wider power once he becomes regent, fearing that only a disciplined, centralized Sword of Caine can survive whatever the Antediluvians truly command.

pages.name: Eleiser de Polanco, Envoy of Mother Spain (Lasombra Elder)

text.content: A thousand-year-old Castilian knight-Cainite who witnessed the Third Generation @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra} founder firsthand and helped the diablerist Gratiano depose him, Don Eleiser de Polanco co-founded Los Reyes de las Sombras ("the Kings of Shadow") in the 17th century to give elder @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra} quiet, subtle control over mortal institutions in @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} domains. After Archbishop Monçada's death in 2000, de Polanco supported Monçada's infamous childe Lucita in claiming the old archbishopric, and now serves in Mexico City as her representative — quietly convinced Regent Galbraith has become a thrall to the Salamanca @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.revenants.JournalEntry.wABwn8FJtAN2e88I]{Grimaldi} revenants (a suspicion Pablo Salamanca y @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.revenants.JournalEntry.wABwn8FJtAN2e88I]{Grimaldi} is desperate to keep him from confirming). De Polanco believes the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s East Coast US holdings are untenable and pushes cardinals to reinforce Detroit, Montreal, and Mexico itself instead.

pages.name: Szechenyi Jolán, Mother of Horrors (Tzimisce Priscus)

text.content: A 6th-generation @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} descended by blood from Lugoj the Bond-Breaker but by birth from the Hungarian revenant family his rebels wiped out, Jolán has spent eight centuries proving her @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} and clan loyalty beyond doubt. She helped develop a purely Discipline-based method for creating vozhd war-ghouls (earning her nickname), oversees the breeding of Mexico City's @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.revenants.JournalEntry.wABwn8FJtAN2e88I]{Grimaldi} revenants, and is the Moderate faction's standard-bearer and candidate for regent. In the mountain hamlet of Sechenia she collects children born with severe birth defects, Blood Bonds them all, raises the strongest as ghoul bodyguards, and occasionally Embraces one as a childe — all part of an ongoing, unsuccessful experiment to breed revenants capable of learning Vicissitude without low-generation vitae, for which she now seeks a captive shapeshifter to add to the bloodline.

pages.name: Venere Carboni, The Demon Maestro (Toreador antitribu Priscus)

text.content: Embraced in 1530s Italy after his lute-playing talent so impressed a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} pack that they spared him mid-massacre, Venere Carboni rose to priscus and became Regent Galbraith's "party whip," charming and negotiating support for her coalition and positioning himself as the consistory's @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference.JournalEntry.St7uVm2DqK4nRy8X]{Status} Quo candidate and advocate for smaller antitribu lineages against the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra}-@UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} duopoly. One of the greatest musicians in the world after centuries of practice, he weaves @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} emotion-manipulation into his playing at Condesa nightclubs, staging playlets of lust, jealousy, and rage among unwitting mortal audiences, and privately considers himself Galbraith's natural successor as regent. He deliberately and spitefully ruined the mortal life of the musician Jesús Alcalá simply because the young man reminded him of his own breathing days.

pages.name: Father Yoel Rosen, Sin-Eater (Tzimisce, Machete Cross Priest)

text.content: The last survivor of a dozen devout mortals Dr. Vermudo de Sancha tortured to test whether faith could withstand true suffering, Father Rosen's forgiveness of his torturer so unsettled de Sancha that he Embraced the elderly priest to test his faith against the Curse of Caine directly. Rosen's mind broke the first time hunger overrode his prayers, and he now believes he steals his victims' sins along with their blood, dying them in a state of grace; he warps his flesh to resemble famous saints while hunting, leading to police reports the authorities dismiss as drunken hallucinations. He leads the Machete Cross, a liberation-theology @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} pack that murders wealthy "oppressors" and gives the proceeds to the poor, and suffers @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.derangements.JournalEntry.54b2022695f143c1]{Sanguinary Animism} and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.derangements.JournalEntry.96c107ceb8714b9b]{Fugue} derangements that manifest as "confessions" heard from victims and stigmata under stress.

pages.name: Ana Rita Montaña, The Barren Virgin (Tzimisce)

text.content: An upper-class creole woman driven to religious delusion by abusive convent "treatment" for her libertine mortal behavior, Montaña believed she was impregnated by the Holy Ghost, was hidden away by a scandal-fearing abbess, and was mistakenly buried alive during an 1813 epidemic before Efraín Sortano's scavenging hounds dug her free and he Embraced her. She now believes herself the Virgin of the Carmelites in a "failed" divine form, distends her fingers into flail-like mortification tools, and cultivates a cult of blood-enthralled nuns (including the current Carmelite abbess) whom she seduces and whips while awaiting the next "blessed virgin." She remains on good terms with her sire Sortano and her ex-lover Bishop Rodolfo, either of whom would protect her if needed.

pages.name: Ikraam al-Biruni, Refugee Sorcerer (Assamite antitribu)

text.content: An elderly Kurdish scholar-sorcerer who fled the resurgent Methuselah ur-Shulgi's demand that all Assamites abandon young faiths like Islam, Ikraam sought refuge with the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} antitribu, only to find them ignorant of his clan's true traditions. He depends on Caridad de Flores for kalif (vitae-fed cannabis used in @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} sorcery) and pays for it in service — spying, cursing, and stealing for her — despite being older and more powerful than most of the neonates who bully him. Ikraam hopes to find real Assamites or a Mexican Mafia connection to secure an independent kalif supply, and gently but firmly corrects anyone who calls him an Arab: he is a Kurd.

pages.name: Matias Cazimirski, The Biker of Blood (Assamite antitribu)

text.content: A middle-class Jewish teenager from Polanco who was Embraced after being caught spying on a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}-run gang, Matias survived his sire Juan Brazos' destruction in a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} attack on New York (fleeing home with Clova Haines' help) only to be shunned by the Black Hand as a suspected coward. Desperate to belong somewhere, he throws himself into daredevil motorcycle stunts and chainsaw drive-by attacks for the Institutional Devolutionary Party while obsessively collecting scraps of real @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} lore, hoping to someday meet a "real" @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} like Ikraam al-Biruni who could teach him what his heritage actually means.

pages.name: La Malinche (Rosa, Brujah antitribu, Feral Escapee)

text.content: A Salvadoran refugee trafficked and abused across the US-Mexico border, Rosa killed her captor and was then mob-Embraced by Bishop Natalio's coven in a ritual meant to create a "La Malinche" symbol of betrayal — but she escaped the ritus before her Creation Rites completed, tasting her first human blood on a tour bus of American tourists. Now a feral, politically unaffiliated @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} antitribu hiding in the eastern shantytowns, she is being stalked in her daytime visions by a mysterious white-robed, death's-head-wearing woman, and is trying to track down a murderous "mestiza" she has glimpsed (in truth one of the Hungry Sisters) in hopes of finding others like herself. Natalio wants her found and dealt with before word of his ritus's failure spreads; others see her as a useful, ownerless pawn.

pages.name: Mariano Pomposo, Black Hand Census Taker (Brujah antitribu)

text.content: A former labor-dispute enforcer (los chombos) Embraced by Maria de Zumárraga for his gift of psychological intimidation over blunt violence, Mariano Pomposo now serves as the Black Hand's Mexico City census taker — tracking every pack, loner, and new Lick in the city, interviewing them with a PDA and a holstered pistol, and compiling near-psychological profiles the Black Hand can use against any Cainite who becomes inconvenient. Nicknamed "Mr. Freeze" for his unshakeable calm, Pomposo hoards favors and blackmail leverage rather than spending them, waiting for the right unforeseen crisis to put them to use.

pages.name: Jesús Alcalá, El Lobo de Canto (Gangrel antitribu, Sabbat Propagandist)

text.content: A mariachi musician Embraced by the City @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} Hartmann Strauss specifically to write Loyalist protest songs, Jesús became El Grito de Dolor's greatest propagandist, his vampirocorridos about Lupine hunts and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} elders spreading through Mexico City's @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} within weeks of composition and inflicting real short-term prestige loss on anyone he satirizes. The elder @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} antitribu Venere Carboni deliberately ruined Jesús' mortal life out of professional jealousy before his Embrace and has never fully abandoned the idea of finishing the job. Jesús' closest-guarded secret is his search — through old Mexican Mafia contacts — for the teenage children he lost track of during his @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} indoctrination, a mortal attachment that could badly damage his standing in El Grito de Dolor if it became known.

pages.name: Bishop Rodolfo, Witness to the End Times (Malkavian antitribu)

text.content: A 6th-generation @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} Embraced circa 150 AD by the Methuselah oracle Tryphosa, Rodolfo spent millennia as her herald delivering unheeded warnings of doom before a philosophical rift over free will versus fate turned into lasting estrangement. When Tryphosa and her @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} allies conspired to suppress clanwide Dementation for the sake of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} stability, Rodolfo defected to the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} to keep the Discipline alive, arriving in Mexico City in 1848 and cultivating deliberately repulsive habits to seem harmless. He now leads an informal global symposium on Dementation from a filth-strewn Zona Rosa mansion, believes the 1999 Week of Nightmares proved his predictions of escalating madness correct, and has taken on the Camarilla turncoat Eliza Villanova as his student and oracular partner — unaware, or unwilling to admit, that his own diablerie may be in the offing, possibly at her hands.

pages.name: Eliza Villanova, The Searcher (Malkavian antitribu)

text.content: A former @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} in Atlanta whose latent oracular Dementation reawakened during a chance clan encounter in 1997, Eliza abandoned the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} after glimpsing the Madness Network's shared vision of Gehenna, joined the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s sack of Atlanta in 1999, and traveled to Mexico City to study under Bishop Rodolfo — the only teacher she could find versed in the clan's lost prophetic traditions. She has since used the Madness Network to touch minds as far as Gdansk and Montevideo, but privately considers Rodolfo and his ally La Viuda Blanca too fascinated by the apocalypse to be useful allies when it truly arrives, and is quietly courting Bishop Natalio and Don Eleiser de Polanco as alternative allies for the coming crisis.

pages.name: Icarus, The Manchurian Candidate (Nosferatu antitribu)

text.content: Douglas Portillo was an Atlanta @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} information broker ("Pawnshop") until the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s invasion frame job made him look like a diablerist; fleeing Kindred primogen tore through his mind searching for @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} secrets, shattering his identity between Portillo and an equally uncertain "real" self, Vicente Loizillon. Unable to reconcile either fractured identity, he renamed himself Icarus Falling and fled to Mexico City, believing something in his broken memories ties him to the city and possibly the Black Hand (he has no explanation for the missing brand on his hand). He squats in cemetery crypts using Obfuscate, occasionally accepting hospitality from the sympathetic Joseph O'Grady, and grows increasingly afraid after a flicker of recognition from Teresita suggested someone may finally be watching him.

pages.name: Feo Ramos, The Cainite Cabbie (Panders)

text.content: A poor Chalco-born hustler-turned-cab-driver who survived an ill-fated @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} plot as an unintended shovelhead decoy, Feo Ramos now works Mexico City's international airport as the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s unofficial concierge — arranging havens, hunting grounds, and introductions for visiting Cainites in exchange for tips, favors, and standing with El Grito de Dolor. Feo cultivates every relationship as a potential asset and will cheerfully sell out a visiting character to a local bishop's favor without a flicker of guilt, though he personally avoids violence and reads minds with Auspex to keep every conversation exactly as pleasant as it needs to be.

pages.name: Jaggedy Andy, Filth Angel (Panders)

text.content: An obnoxious American tourist made an example of by the priscus Sascha Vykos, Andy Jeffries spat in Vykos' face rather than beg during a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} Blood Feast and was rewarded with a skull-and-flesh seal grown over his entire face before being Embraced into a slow suffocating death. Jaime Sangriento's Filth Angels found him thrashing in a landfill and taught him to chisel his own face open with a hammer and chisel each dusk to see, hear, and feed. A year later, still refusing to accept his death, Andy is Vinculi-bound to the pack and cannot leave their landfill, but has begun sneaking out at night — a dangerous fault line given Jaime's edict against outsiders and Andy's still-simmering, carefully hidden contempt for his rescuers.

pages.name: Abbie Norberg, Failed Templar (Serpents of the Light)

text.content: A blind alcoholic widow recruited by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ssX4b2JFXF2uegC3]{Followers of Set} at her lowest point, Abbie Norberg's clan-crossing sect (the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.antitribu.JournalEntry.Ohsrh5ieQL7q3Ewk]{Serpents of the Light}) joined the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} generations ago; her heightened non-visual senses made her a favorite subject of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} antitribu researchers and eventually earned her the post of templar guarding Regent Melinda Galbraith personally — a post she held, unknowingly, the very night Galbraith was murdered and replaced by the impostor Zachary Sikorsky. "Galbraith" has shunned her ever since for reasons Abbie cannot fathom, driving her into self-blaming despair; she can be roused from her decline only by a genuine chance to find the real regent's killer and redeem her failed duty.

pages.name: Miguel Orozco (Toreador antitribu, Encapuchados)

text.content: A former Tijuana Cartel enforcer Embraced by Los Muertos Alegres, Miguel Orozco and his partner Carlos Diáz convinced their pack that the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s usual poverty was pointless when organized crime money was there for the taking; the resulting coven, the Encapuchados, worked protection and drug-running for the Tijuana Cartel until Bishop Natalio exposed and sanctioned them. Undeterred, Orozco now Embraces cartel members and courts ex-cartel neonates to build Vaulderie-bound loyalty instead of open warfare, hoping to seize territory from the collapsing Gulf Cartel for a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}-aligned "Orozco Cartel" — a scheme that risks provoking a cartel war the Sabbat cannot win if the major cartels ever trace the pattern back to him.

pages.name: Joseph O'Grady, Ductus of El Calpulli Rojo (Ventrue antitribu)

text.content: A Mexico City-born Irish-Mexican (Patricio) forcibly Embraced and brutalized by his own violent pack, the Bean-Sidhe, O'Grady fled to El Calpulli Rojo — Frances Derossi's neutral haven for @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} uncomfortable with the sect's savagery — and eventually succeeded Derossi as ductus. He has made the compound far more active than under his predecessor, personally seeking out Cainites trapped by violence and ignorance as he once was, and has become an unofficial confessor for defectors from other packs, accumulating minor secrets and favors he uses sparingly against real threats. His hidden combat skill (honed surviving the Bean-Sidhe) surprises the few Cainites who mistake his pacifism for weakness.

pages.name: Rico Loco, The Mad Bomber (Ventrue antitribu)

text.content: A bullied, bookish mortal who found confidence in homemade fireworks and later real explosives, Ricardo Alvarez became a student radical after the Tlatelolco massacre, was Embraced by El Grito de Dolor's Rosa-Maria Obregón as her ghoul-turned-childe, and now serves as the coven's cheerfully indiscriminate demolitions expert. Rico will bomb @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}, independent, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}, or mortal targets alike as long as it lets him watch something explode, rationalizing every hit on a fellow @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} as proof the victim had fallen from true loyalty — though the Black Hand's real complaint is that his methods leave nothing behind to diablerize.

vtmlarp.source: Mexico City by Night, Chapters Three and Four
